selection_status: Candidates, pending user screening; not mastery evidence
method: Read all 695 subtitle cues in three consecutive batches of no more than 240 cues. Inspect outer communication frames and inner collocations/idioms; exclude credit and background-TV dialogue, known basic formulae and isolated unfamiliar words. Deduplicate within episode and against existing E01–E04 selections, retaining only distinct construction or sense where repeated. Quotes join consecutive original cues with spaces, preserve wording, false starts and presentation tags. Subtitle-only extraction, not audio-verified.

lexical_checks.note: Verified US informal idiom: discuss honestly and directly; rate negotiation is contextual.

items.chunk: I need you to do sth.
